verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll/HR platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so plugging third-party MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers only server-side and agent-facing capabilities: an official MCP server (Embedded Dev Assistant and the mcp.api.gusto.com remote server) and an agent-driven CLI with bundled skills. These expose Gusto to external agents rather than letting Gusto consume other MCP servers' tools, and they do not transfer to this client-role story.
